title: East Commonlands tunnel
summary: Your home base for classes, shops, tradeskills and blessings.
body:
Live testing — Hate Keeper in Commonlands: Find the Plane of Hate Keeper in East Commonlands at /loc -1570,-346,3, between Mirielle and Khalure in the travel area. Raid, Grind and return entry lead to Hate; private Hate instances retain an entrance Keeper. Public and private Hate entry require level 46; GM status is no longer required. The server update is installed. The owner confirmed the relocation, Commonlands visibility and Hate travel. Broader dungeon balance and full-clear QA remain separate.

Not released: The separate level-65/Planes of Power profile and its additional merchant stock remain staged. This item/spell release keeps Classic level 50 and the current travel and vendor gates.

A shared tunnel home base

The East Commonlands tunnel brings all 16 trainer-and-spell-shop pairs together in four compact gatherings around campfires. Matching outfits help you find each pair.

A dedicated tradeskill workshop

Find supplier groups and six crafting stations in the tunnel workshop. Numbered merchant pages hold larger catalogs. Stacked materials and Craft All reduce repeated preparation. Haldra, Smithing Supplies III, stocks Leather Padding. Hail Artisan Veyra for the free Reforging Box; the Epic Forgemaster handles the separate epic quest.

More complete shops through numbered pages

Large spell and tradeskill catalogs use numbered shop pages so the available stock fits into usable merchant windows.

A livelier gathering place

Named residents share a campfire. Traders are grouped around the tunnel, with eight walkers following routes around the service areas.

Residents with local conversation

Named residents bring occasional local conversation and auction calls to the tunnel, alongside the walking routes and campfire gatherings.

Finite tunnel-trader offers

Custom tunnel traders have limited buy and sell offers, with two offers per trader. Stock can run out; prices and earning rates remain part of balance testing.

Limited finds at city merchants

City merchants can receive small quantities of special finds as part of the custom market. Availability changes with the market’s stock.

Free buffs for your level

Hail Matron Restora for movement, health, armor, regeneration, and mana-regeneration buffs suited to your level. Check back every ten levels for the next package.

Bank near the buff services

Mira Coinwell provides native banking beside the buff and service area. The Ancient Chronicler, Bartholomew and Tessa also use that service nook. Bank valuables before using Sell All.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

Camil Silvermist offers The Vigil of the Dawn to level-50 characters holding Paladin in any class slot. He starts the personal story and delivers the earned helmet. Make room in Tasks for both story and dungeon journals. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.

This update is in Change Log →

Player bazaar — live testing

The Commonlands bazaar is installed for testing with native /bazaar search and purchases without a parked auctioneer. Confirmed listings stay available while their seller adventures or logs out. Native search, inspection and direct delivery still need player verification.

To post: in public East Commonlands, place one permanent tradable item or stack on an empty cursor and use #bazaar post <price-pp>. The quoted price is per unit; confirm the exact item, quantity and total with #bazaar confirm <nonce> within 60 seconds. Keep at most 100 active listings. Use #bazaar listings to view them, #bazaar cancel <id> to reclaim remaining stock, and #bazaar collect to collect proceeds.

Buyers use direct-to-inventory delivery with an empty cursor; items arrive on the cursor, with no extra delivery fee. Partial stack purchases are supported. Filled bags, temporary items, evolving/scaling items and saved metadata that cannot be reproduced exactly are rejected before posting. Existing equipment requirements still apply. No item stats, NPC stock or rewards are added by this market.

Sell / My Listings — live testing

Fully exit EverQuest and use the launcher’s Play button to update. In public East Commonlands, open /bazaar and choose Sell / My Listings. Search remains on the first tab.

  1. Pick up the item you want to sell. Enter a whole-platinum price per item, then click Post Item.
  2. Review the item, quantity, price each and total. Click Confirm Post within 60 seconds. Your item enters the market and remains listed while you are offline.
  3. To remove a listing, select your own row, click Cancel and confirm. Keep your cursor empty to receive it.
  4. Click Collect to claim sale proceeds. The panel shows your available balance.

If a reply times out, use Refresh to check current state before trying an action again. The commands above remain available. Native rendering, search, offline buying and seller collection are still being verified in game.

Live testing: The client repair addresses Post doing nothing for a supported price-text format and makes seller text larger and lighter. After updating, review the item and total price before Confirm Post. If your saved window is short, enlarge it or scroll to the controls.
